Each allocated ton earns $1000. Your goal is to optimize your own income in the long run over many months. At month end, if at least 25 tons remain, a natural replenishment restores stock to 500 with probability75%; otherwise (probability25%) remaining stock doubles, capped at 500. If fewer than 25 tons remain, the fishery collapses to zero. Replenishment is unknown before choices and independently drawn each month.
